children: URSB appointed Raymond J. Vanaria, CPA to the United Roosevelt Savings Bank board effective October 28, 2026.
Raymond J. Vanaria, CPA joins the bank's board with term starting October 28, 2026.
Vanaria is a member of Malesardi, Quackenbush, Swift & Company in Englewood, NJ, bringing accounting expertise.
Appointment was recommended by investor Lawrence B. Seidman, signaling investor engagement in governance.
Vanaria has prior board experience with publicly traded community banks, potentially strengthening oversight.
